title: Tropical Springtails - 100ml 2x50ml tub - Approx 60+ Clean Up Crew - Bioactive Terrarium
description:
50ml Pot of Tropical White Springtails
Upgrade your enclosure with our healthy cultures of Tropical White Springtails. These tiny arthropods are the backbone of any successful bioactive ecosystem.

 Why you need them:
Bioactive Powerhouse: Acting as a natural "Clean Up Crew," they eat mold and decaying matter, preventing fungal outbreaks in humid terrariums.
Premium Nutrition: Aside from cleaning, they serve as an excellent supplemental food source. They are rich in protein and amino acids, essential for the growth of small reptiles and amphibians.
Hunter Stimulation: Live food triggers the natural hunting instincts of your pets, providing necessary mental and physical stimulation that powdered diets cannot offer.

 Suitable For:
Dart Frogs
Mourning Geckos
Spiderlings & Scorpions
Isopod bins
Snail tanks
Perfect for Bioactive Setups as a Natural Clean Up Crew
Low Maintenance Live Food Suitable for Small Reptiles, Invertebrates, and Amphibians
Rich Source of Protein and Amino Acids
Encourages Natural Feeding Behaviours, Stimulating Mental and Physical Activity
